description: Every .cue file under contracts/ must have a schema_version field. Parse returns Err(MissingSchemaVersion) when absent.
Every .cue file under contracts/ must have a kind field matching one of the 6 enum values. Parse returns Err(InvalidKind) for unknown values.
parse_vet_exit_code handles all i32 exit codes without panic. Exit code 0 => vet passes, non-zero => vet fails.
compare_semver(old, new) returns positive iff new > old in semver ordering. Bounded: major/minor/patch are u32.
Discovery output is sorted by file path. 100 random shuffles produce identical sorted output.
gate_evidence_from_report(total, valid, invalid) always returns Ok(GateEvidence) when valid + invalid = total. No overflow on u32 addition.
ContractKind::all_values() returns exactly 6 variants. Exhaustive match on ContractKind covers all cases.
discover() on empty contracts/ directory returns Report with total=0, valid=0, invalid=0, status=Pass.
No undefined behavior in contract-discovery module. Run cargo miri test on xtask.
CUE schema #ContractMeta enforces schema_version: string and kind: enum at schema level.
